topics.topic: How an enumeration-reading row identifies its applicable enumeration or allowed values
questions: Which enumeration supplies the members for a row, and does the row carry that enumeration or its allowed values as a fact?
Does an enumeration-reading row identify a particular enumeration, and if so, what fact identifies it?
When the reading kind is enumeration, what fact identifies the particular enumeration whose member values are valid?

quotes:
A row's `name` is
the field's name: its path in the `OwnerRequest` or `OwnerValues` it fills
(`carrier`), parts joined by a full stop, with a tuple's position written
where the row holds `OWNER_FORM_POSITION_MARK` (`#`), as decimal digits
from 0. A row's `reads_as` says how the field's text is read: as the text
itself, an integer's decimal digits, `true` or `false`, or an enumeration
member's value.
judgement.why: The later contract makes the row identify an exact typed destination through its carrier and path, so that destination field supplies the enumeration rather than a separate allowed-value fact in OwnerFormField.

quotes: Facts: the field's name; what it fills; how its text is read.

Field names, types,
formal optionality and every answer shape belong to State 6; orders, replay
mechanisms, correction semantics and token scopes belong to State 2 (State 0,
"Carried to later states"; codex round-01 T5).
judgement.why: State 1 decides the domain facts, while their complete field names, types and formal optionality are expressly assigned to State 6, where SPEC_STANDARD §5 applies.

A row's `name` is
the field's name: its path in the `OwnerRequest` or `OwnerValues` it fills
(`carrier`), parts joined by a full stop, with a tuple's position written
where the row holds `OWNER_FORM_POSITION_MARK` (`#`), as decimal digits

Is this prohibition global to every owner-interface request, or only to requests and destinations explicitly covered by OWNER_FORM_FIELDS?
Which owner-interface product actions create or select these rows and which actions read them, and how does a row identify the page or action to which it applies?

quotes:
Which action a request names, by its
method and path, and whether it is a change or touches an uploaded file, are
the rows of the data provider's `OWNER_ACTIONS`; its target is the query
parameter `OWNER_TARGET_PARAMETER` names, its CSRF value the form field
`OWNER_CSRF_FIELD` names, every other field it reads or a page writes a row
of `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS` (owner, 2026-11-25), the session cookie's name
`OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` and its attributes
`OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES`, and a page's HTTP status the service API's
`SERVICE_ANSWER_STATUS` and `REFUSAL_HTTP_STATUSES` (owner, 2026-11-24).

Every other field is a row of the
data provider's `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS` (`OwnerFormField`). A row's `name` is
the field's name: its path in the `OwnerRequest` or `OwnerValues` it fills
(`carrier`), parts joined by a full stop, with a tuple's position written
where the row holds `OWNER_FORM_POSITION_MARK` (`#`), as decimal digits
from 0.
judgement.why: The later texts make OWNER_FORM_FIELDS global to every non-target, non-CSRF owner-interface field that a page writes or a request reads, with rows selected by carrier and destination path rather than by a page or action fact.

What closed set of location facts does an OwnerFormField contain: a request path, a path into a values collection, a tuple position, or some defined combination, and which of them are optional or mutually exclusive?

quotes:
A row's `name` is
the field's name: its path in the `OwnerRequest` or `OwnerValues` it fills
(`carrier`), parts joined by a full stop, with a tuple's position written
where the row holds `OWNER_FORM_POSITION_MARK` (`#`), as decimal digits
from 0.
judgement.why: The later contract chooses one path encoded in the row's name, a carrier selecting OwnerRequest or OwnerValues, and an in-path position marker rather than separate optional path, values or tuple-position facts.

quotes:
Substitution: two rows with equal facts are the same fact of the table.
Continuity: none; changed only with a new release.

A row's `name` is
the field's name: its path in the `OwnerRequest` or `OwnerValues` it fills
(`carrier`), parts joined by a full stop, with a tuple's position written
where the row holds `OWNER_FORM_POSITION_MARK` (`#`), as decimal digits
from 0. A row's `reads_as` says how the field's text is read: as the text
itself, an integer's decimal digits, `true` or `false`, or an enumeration
member's value.
judgement.why: The later contract resolves the apparent omission by encoding the destination path and tuple-position placeholder in the name fact and the destination model in carrier, so differences in those values participate in value identity through the stated facts.

topics.topic: Who creates OwnerFormField values and from which authoritative source
questions: Who authors or derives each OwnerFormField value, and from what authoritative input does the data provider mint the release constant?

Who creates OwnerFormField values at release construction, and are they copied directly from OWNER_FORM_FIELDS, constructed from some other provider records, or derived by the owner-interface implementation?

quotes: Not persisted; a constant of the release.
judgement.why: The text identifies the release's data-provider constant as the authoritative creator and source of the non-persisted OwnerFormField values; no runtime derivation is part of the model.

topics.topic: Whether OwnerFormField is a generated runtime model or read-only specification data
questions: Is OwnerFormField a runtime value model instantiated in generated code from the provider constant, or is it read-only spec data whose table has a catalog, mapping or vocabulary kind and does not reach generated code?

quotes:
`OwnerAuditAction` (an owner action,
a customer mark's transition or a project erasure's kind where the action
has one, and the audit action it writes) with `OwnerAction`,
`CustomerTransition`, `ProjectErasure` and `AuditAction` for
`OWNER_AUDIT_ACTIONS`; `OwnerFormField` (an owner form field's name, the
model it fills and how its text is read) with `OwnerFormCarrier` and
`FormValueKind` for `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS`. Its other constants are scalars and import nothing.

The values from every generator's prompt: a generated consumer is given the
name and type of a constant and imports it, so the running code reads the
value while the generator never sees it (SPEC_STANDARD §15.9).
judgement.why: The later module design treats OwnerFormField as the model type of the typed OWNER_FORM_FIELDS runtime constant, which generated owner-interface code imports and reads, rather than as generation-only catalog data.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
